data.name: Archonia: The Neon City
data.detailed_description:
Enter the city of Archonia.

A game inspired by Gmod's DarkRP, set in a neon-soaked temple to capitalism and consumption.

This is an immersive simulation game where players join a dynamic world full of other players (we're shooting for 100-200 in a single server) and embody a new identity in the city of Archonia. Players will be treated to a massive open world to explore, diverse playstyles and roles to embody, and many systems to experiment with. 

Players can join one of several factions that are integral to the city's world while taking on various roles of the citizens, the police, criminals, the government, or even those actively seeking to destroy the city.

A large part of this game will be the unscripted experiences players create together, and that will lead to many unexpected outcomes!

Maybe you want to take the game very seriously, and get heavily invested and dig deep into your immersion. Or maybe you just want to cause some chaos. Archonia welcomes both.

Here's a small slice of what you can do in Archonia:

Explore a massive sprawl of a city

Engage with other players, forming groups, rivals, or businesses

Take on a role, level up, and use your abilities to shape the world around you: for better or worse.

Join factions with specific goals that change how the city feels, and even whether it lives or dies

Own properties from apartments, shops, penthouses, safehouses, companies, etc.

Install cybermods that boost stats or unlock unique abilities

Craft a myriad of items from weapons, drugs, crypto miners, and even occult items

Buy stocks in a dynamic market that is definitely not rigged!

Join the police and enforce law and order

Or join the opposition and work to destroy it!

Run companies in a hybrid "tycoon style" gameplay

Work jobs in the city to earn money, from mining to garbage collection, or even bounty hunting

And so, so much more.

Here's a small roll call of some of the roles you can play... there's a ton more!

Want updates and to watch progress? Join the Discord or follow me on Twitch

You can find the links in the socials section on this page.

data.short_description: One city. Thousands of ways to live in it. Become a cop, kingpin, CEO, or anarchist in Archonia: a sprawling cyberpunk metropolis shaped entirely by its players. Own property, run companies, install cybermods, rig the market, and decide whether the city thrives or falls. Welcome to Archonia.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 270K Plus
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 5070 TI 16GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: N/A
  • Additional Notes: These are my PC specs. Will have to do some player testing at a later date. GB disk space is a large overestimate.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 5070 TI 16GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
